text:
The loop itself has the right polarity, but MN1 has almost no headroom. Its drain `x` sits at only 0.137 V above its source `ea`, because `x` is clamped by MN3's Vgs (0.744 V) while ea sits at Veb ≈ 0.607 V. Across the VDD sweep and over temperature MN1 drops into triode and the loop breaks. That would explain the 1.44 V/V line regulation and the 5397 ppm/C TC. It may also explain the gmin-stepping failures.

The fix is to raise `x`:
- Add a source-degeneration resistor Rs under MN3, sized to drop about 0.25 V.
- Lower MN3's gm/Id so its Vgs rises.
- Raise gmid_n, which the sensitivities say is the strongest lever on both TC and line regulation.

Together these should put about 0.3 to 0.4 V of margin on MN1.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "MN1 Vds-Vdsat=0.05V: x clamped at Vgs(MN3)≈Veb+0.14, so MN1 goes triode over VDD/temp and the loop breaks (line_reg 1.44, TC 5397). Add source resistor under MN3 (+~0.25V on x), lower gmid3, raise gmid_n per sensitivities."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "R1":    (250e3, 120e3, 600e3),   # PTAT resistor
    "k3":    (11.5, 7.0, 16.0),       # R3/R1 ratio -> TC trim
    "vref_t":(0.91, 0.85, 1.0),       # target Vref -> sets R4 (sim ran ~5% high)
    "Lp":    (4.0, 1.0, 10.0),        # PMOS mirror L
    "gmid_p":(14.0, 8.0, 18.0),
    "Ln":    (2.0, 0.5, 6.0),         # NMOS level-shift pair L
    "gmid_n":(22.0, 14.0, 26.0),
    "gmid3": (4.5, 3.0, 10.0),        # MN3 driver
    "Vrs":   (0.25, 0.1, 0.4),        # drop on MN3 source resistor -> lifts x, MN1 headroom
    "Cx":    (2e-12, 0.3e-12, 6e-12), # dominant-pole cap at x
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    N = 8
    mQ1 = 4
    mQ2 = mQ1 * N
    R1 = p["R1"]
    R3 = p["k3"] * R1
    dVbe = UT * math.log(N)
    Ip = dVbe / R1
    Veb = 0.65
    for _ in range(6):
        Veb = 0.76 - UT * math.log(10e-6 / (Ip / mQ1))
    Ic = Veb / R3
    I = Ip + Ic
    R4 = p["vref_t"] / I
    Rs = p["Vrs"] / I

    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.5)
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I, vds=0.4, vsb=Veb)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid3"], 4.0, I, vds=0.4, vsb=p["Vrs"])

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # PMOS mirror, pg set by diode MP4 driven by MN3
    n.dev("MP1", "x", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MP2", "nb", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MP3", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("MP4", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    # NMOS level-shift pair: MN2 diode on R1 side, MN1 amplifies into x
    n.dev("MN2", "nb", "nb", "eb", "vss", mn)
    n.dev("MN1", "x", "nb", "ea", "vss", mn)
    # driver stage with source degeneration to raise V(x)
    n.dev("MN3", "pg", "x", "s3", "vss", m3)
    n.R("RS", "s3", "vss", Rs)
    # PNP core
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "ea", m=mQ1)
    n.R("R1", "eb", "e2", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=mQ2)
    n.R("R3A", "ea", "vss", R3)
    n.R("R3B", "eb", "vss", R3)
    n.R("R4", "vref", "vss", R4)
    n.C("CX", "x", "vss", p["Cx"])
    # start-up: vref low -> sx high -> pull pg low
    n.M("MS2", "sx", "vref", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20)
    n.M("MS3", "sx", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.84, 1.0)
    n.M("MS1", "pg", "sx", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.84, 0.5)

    dVeb_dT = (Veb - 1.17 - 3 * UT) / 300.0
    dI_dT = dVeb_dT / R3 + (dVbe / 300.0) / R1
    vref = I * R4
    slope = dI_dT * R4
    curv = 0.004
    tc = (abs(slope) * 165 + curv) / vref / 165 * 1e6
    line_reg = vref * (mp.gds / I) * 1.5
    power = 1.8 * (4 * I + 20e-9)
    psrr = -db(line_reg) if line_reg > 0 else 60
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "line_reg": line_reg,
               "power": power, "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1}
```
